title: Chained Prompt Injection through retrieval (RAGBot)
summary: Disclosure of internal knowledge base documents (admin credentials, personal data). As documented, also execution of instructions found in retrieved content.

LC.rationale: The attacker's chat message is matched by regex and directly drives the scripted reply that lists the knowledge base documents, with no independent transformation reducing language to validated fields (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-332, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1285-1290).

CP.rationale: RAGBot answers only the latest user turn; the knowledge base is static with no ingestion path, and cross-session persistence exists only in MemoryBot (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:327-331, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848).

AP.rationale: The effect is confined to the RAGBot reply; no handoff or cross-principal propagation is implemented (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770).

RH.rationale: No evaluator, verifier or reward channel is on the path; the reply is a scripted chat response and no reward-hacking episode is documented (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/agent-success-paths.js:72-106).

ES.rationale: RAGBot's only declared tool is a scripted outbound call, and no dynamic or unvetted extension is bound on the assessed path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-376).

agentic_applicability.rationale: The lab documents the RAGBot path as retrieving internal documents whose planted instructions are inserted into the prompt and executed, which models model-directed goal pursuit and action selection.
